commands.name: DanOS Home / Cockpit Overview
commands.description: Calm local cockpit overview: registry, tasks, agents, cmux/tmux readiness, and next actions.

commands.name: Hermes Tool / Hermes CLI Mission Control
commands.description: Peer AI assistant surface: conversation, sessions, models, tools, auth, notes, ops — not merged with OpenClaw.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux attach -t mission-hermes || /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces/bin/mission-hermes --no-attach && tmux attach -t mission-hermes'

commands.name: OpenClaw Tool / OpenClaw CLI Mission Control
commands.description: Peer AI runtime surface alongside Hermes. Missing features show unsupported/not configured — pane stays visible.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux attach -t mission-openclaw || /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces/bin/mission-openclaw --no-attach && tmux attach -t mission-openclaw'

commands.name: Coding Workbench
commands.description: Neovim, runway, review, browser testing, project docs. Hermes/OpenClaw chat lives in mission controls — not here.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; CMUX_SESSION=cockpit-workbench CMUX_TITLE="Coding Workbench" /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces/bin/tmux-workbench --no-attach --project=/Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces >/dev/null && tmux attach -d -t cockpit-workbench'

commands.name: Agent Deck
commands.description: Worktrees, agent slots, diff review gates. One agent, one branch, one worktree.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux has-session -t cockpit-workbench 2>/dev/null || CMUX_SESSION=cockpit-workbench CMUX_TITLE="Coding Workbench" /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces/bin/tmux-workbench --no-attach --project=/Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces >/dev/null; tmux select-window -t cockpit-workbench:agents; tmux attach -d -t cockpit-workbench'

commands.name: Open Source Radar / Community
commands.description: Project registry, GitHub PRs/issues, Dan's PRs, discussions, Discord drafts — no surprise posting.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux attach -t cockpit-community || /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-tmux-workspaces/bin/cockpit-community --no-attach && tmux attach -t cockpit-community'

commands.description: Open canonical Hermes Obsidian vault (terminal cwd + Obsidian or Finder).
